mappings.rationale: Proxy for apply/volume: multi-file repository tasks partly exercise large-scope edits; aggregate score, not a volume measurement. No verify mapping: the index does not measure review or verification of an existing change.
Proxy for apply/domains: tasks span several components; not a measurement of cross-domain design. No verify mapping: the index does not measure review or verification of an existing change.
Proxy for apply/layers: terminal and code tasks cross tooling/code boundaries; not a per-layer measurement. No verify mapping: the index does not measure review or verification of an existing change.

Proxy for apply/architecture: implementation tasks include design decisions; aggregate pass rate is not an architecture measurement. No verify mapping: the index does not measure review or verification of an existing change.

Proxy for apply/logic: implementation tasks require non-trivial algorithms; aggregate pass rate, not a logic-only measurement. No verify mapping: the index does not measure review or verification of an existing change.

note: Independent measurements read from the public Artificial Analysis coding-agents page (rendered charts) on 2026-11-14. Only exact harness/model/effort matches for catalog candidates are recorded. Mappings are proxy-only and apply-only; there is no comparable independent verify measurement, so verify coefficients stay heuristic. Haiku 5.5, Luna, Hydrogen and Flash have no record in this snapshot.
